violations.text: The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked. Establishment is to add an indicating symbol to the menu signifying which items are available raw or undercooked to the consumer request. Per PIC, establishment is switching menu items and will add the symbols to reprinted menus. New Violation. Correct By: 11/11/2026

Working containers (spray bottles) used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Spray bottles were labeled during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

Utensils were observed stored in sanitizer between uses. Utensils between uses shall be stored in one of the following manners: in water that is maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or more, in water with sufficient flow to flush particulates to the drain, or on a dry clean surface. Utensils were removed the sanitizer and allowed to air dry prior to returning to service and were placed on a dry clean surface. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026
